ModMetaData.name: Unlocked Schematics
ModMetaData.author: VitaKaninen
ModMetaData.description:
Vanilla never generates research schematics for the Biotech mechtech line, the Odyssey gravtech line, or any Royalty project that needs a techprint - and it keeps refusing even after you have applied the techprint, recruited a mechanitor, or inspected a grav engine. The research is unlocked and ready to study, but no book about it will ever exist.
This mod ties schematic generation to whether the research is actually unlocked, instead of which DLC feature it belongs to. Satisfy the requirement and schematics for that project start appearing like any other.
Crucially, it does not flood your book pool with research you cannot use. A colony that never takes a mechanitor will never see a mechtech schematic. If anything the pool gets tidier: vanilla generates schematics for projects locked behind an unstudied chip - the wastepack atomizer being the usual culprit - and this mod stops that too.
Works with modded research, including techprint-gated projects added by other mods.
Books you already have are left alone. If a requirement later lapses - your only mechanitor dies, say - a schematic you already own stays readable and can still finish that research, exactly as in vanilla. No new ones will spawn until the requirement is met again.
It also drops the research bench from the two interactions that only ever used it as a place to stand. Applying a techprint and analysing a mech chip now happen where the item lies, so you no longer need a bench for either. Nothing is lost by skipping it: neither job reads any stat off the bench, so both take exactly as long as they always did - you just save the walk. The mechanitor requirement on chips is untouched.
Safe to add to an existing save.
